audit.why: Emerald+ 52.79% over 2362 games matches the written shape: Pantheon owns levels 1-5, Karma takes over on scaling. Early is Pantheon's, side lane and late are Karma's.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and 2+item spikes both credit an 'RQ root'. Mantra does not root through Inner Flame.
audit.why: Riot text: Mantra Bonus on Inner Flame (Q) 'creates a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay' — damage only. The root is Focused Resolve (W), and Mantra Bonus on W 'heals herself and extends the root duration'. So her level-6 spike is RW, not RQ, and Mantra is 40s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike restated as Mantra-W (RW): extended root plus a self-heal, on a 40s Mantra cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Focused Resolve cancels Aegis Assault, and never names a single Karma ability.
audit.why: Aegis Assault is a channel (kit flag 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it'). Focused Resolve is hardCC on a flat 12s cooldown at every rank. That is the decisive interaction: her one point-and-click CC deletes your one defensive cooldown, and it is up every 12s regardless of rank.
audit.corrected: Named Focused Resolve, Inner Flame, Inspire, Mantra; stated that Focused Resolve's root cancels Aegis Assault and keyed engages to its flat 12s cooldown.

audit.why: Focused Resolve is 12s flat; Inner Flame is 9/8/7/6/5s; Mantra 40s at rank 1. Those numbers turn 'trade on her cooldown' into an actual instruction.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns written into the mid and spike text.

audit.why: Mantra Bonus on Focused Resolve heals Karma, so extended trades after 6 swing on Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal folded into the late-game text.

edits.before: Karma's R-empowered Q (RQ) gives a long root + tether plus a bigger shield/move-speed E, letting her kite your W and peel out of your all-in.
edits.after: Mantra empowers Focused Resolve (W), not Inner Flame — RW roots longer and heals her, and a root cancels your Aegis Assault. Bait the 40s Mantra.

edits.before: Karma's AP poke scales while your damage plateaus — her RQ root and Liandry's/Luden's poke whittle you from range you cannot close.
edits.after: Karma's AP poke scales while your damage plateaus — 950-range Inner Flame and a 12s Focused Resolve root keep you outside Shield Vault's 600.

edits.before: Karma's RQ becomes a long root + tether and her E shield/move speed jumps, letting her kite your W and peel the all-in.
edits.after: Mantra extends Focused Resolve's root and heals her, and that root cancels Aegis Assault — her peel now beats your commit.

edits.before: Reach 6 and use RQ root to lock you while she pokes you down from outside W range
edits.after: Reach 6 and Mantra Focused Resolve to root you outside Shield Vault's 600 range

edits.before: Hit a clean point-and-click W stun into empowered Q before her E shield is up
edits.after: Land Shield Vault into empowered Comet Spear before Inspire's shield is back up

edits.before: Use E's directional block to eat her Q poke and trade for free while you walk her down
edits.after: Face Aegis Assault at her Inner Flame to eat poke free, but not while Focused Resolve is up

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still yours: empowered-Q poke plus E blocking her Q keeps you ahead, and she can't out-trade you before items. The lane shifts at 6 — her RQ becomes a long root + tether and her E shield/move speed gets stronger, so she can lock you mid-W or slip out of your all-in. Bait that R-empowered Q (dodge the root or eat it on E), and if you can't kill her in lane, leave: Grand Starfall onto mid or jungle banks your early lead before she comes online.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still yours: empowered Comet Spear plus Aegis Assault facing her Inner Flame keeps you ahead. Count Focused Resolve — a flat 12s at every rank, and the one button that matters, because the root cancels your Aegis Assault channel and strips the block you were counting on. Walk up in that 12s gap, never into it. Mantra is 40s at rank 1 and she wants it on Focused Resolve for the longer root and the heal; once spent, commit. If you cannot kill her, Grand Starfall out and bank the lead mid.

edits.before: This is where Karma takes over. Her AP poke scales with items while your damage plateaus, and RQ root + Liandry's/Luden's poke chip you from outside W range — you physically can't close the gap she keeps. Your shields don't save a squishy frame against sustained AP. Don't try to force the duel late; you should already be ahead from levels 1-6. Group, use R to flank, and let your team punish her once she's rooted you and blown cooldowns.
edits.after: This is where Karma takes over. Inner Flame reaches a 5s cooldown at 950 range while your damage plateaus, so she chips you from outside Shield Vault's 600 and you never close. Mantra on Focused Resolve heals her through chip, so buy Grievous Wounds before any extended fight. Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front — it does nothing about the root. You should be ahead from levels 1-5. Group, flank with Grand Starfall, punish once Focused Resolve is spent.

notes: Real error found: the page twice credited Karma with an 'RQ root'. Riot's own text has Mantra Bonus on Inner Flame create a delayed damage cataclysm — no root. The root is Focused Resolve (W) and Mantra Bonus on W extends it and heals her. Both instances corrected. Second point: Pantheon's Aegis Assault carries an 'untargetable' derived flag in champ-data/_kits/pantheon.json, but Riot's description says 'invulnerable to damage from the front' — that is directional damage immunity, not untargetability, and it does not stop CC. I trusted the description. Several _missing-interactions entries for the mirror direction say 'Pantheon can go untargetable through your commit (Aegis Assault)' — those are built on the bad flag and should not be shipped to the opposing pages. Third: the content win[] array and full phases[].side both give Karma Level 1, while whys[0], early and spikes[0] on the same page all say Pantheon wins Level 1 outright, and the packet levelChart gives Pantheon the first four stages. I did not touch the sides — see questionsForUser.
